name: Search Gmail
description: Search the signed-in Gmail account and return the matching mails: subject, sender name and address, date and the preview text. The query uses Gmail search syntax.

query.description: Gmail search, e.g. credits newer_than:3d or from:amazon

account.description: which signed-in Gmail account (0 = the first)

notes: Checked on real Gmail (Oct 2026): rows are tr.zA (unread rows also have zE, so do not use it). Needs the user signed in. An empty list means nothing matched. For mail bodies use gmail-read-mails.
